The gene expression (log2(TPM+1)) distribution across all cell lines in the dataset is positively skewed (right-skewed).

Key supporting metrics:
- Global Skewness (Fisher-Pearson coefficient): +0.6897 (computed across all 32,017,874 expression values from 1,673 cell lines and 19,138 genes).
- Central Tendency: Global Mean (2.6120) is greater than Global Median (2.3423), confirming a longer right-hand tail typical of right-skewed expression data.
- Per-Cell-Line Skewness: 100% of cell lines exhibit positive skewness, with a mean skewness of +0.6941 (median: +0.6791, range: [+0.2673, +2.0193]).
- Per-Gene Skewness: Mean skewness across individual genes is +2.4616 (median: +0.4119).
